title: Chapter 418: Revisiting The Past
content:
Chapter 418: Revisiting The Past

"That's how it is."

The old man Broken Sword was a little surprised, but his expression returned to normal.

He could also understand the drunk old man.

This guy had a weird temper and had few friends around him. Now he and others are leaving him. It's normal for him to find someone to rely on.

"You said, what is that guy who was old at the time doing now?"

The drunk old man looked out the window and asked suddenly.

Hearing this, the old man Duanjian thought for a while and smiled and said, "I guess he'll sit somewhere to have tea."

"You know, that guy likes tea the most, and it's strange to say, how could you, a guy who loves drinking, be friends with him."

Hearing this, Old Man Zui also smiled.

He was almost forgetting the long-lasting memories.

He only knew that Shi Tianzhi was a very worthy friend.

And just as the old man Broken Sword said, Shi Tianzhi was indeed drinking tea at this time.

.........

"Mr. Lord, I have been drinking tea for so many years, but only your jasmine tea is the most popular."

In a quiet pavilion, two figures sat opposite each other, and from a distance, they looked a little blurry.

Shi Tianzhi held the teacup in his hand and savored it carefully, but in fact he focused on the person opposite him.

Lu Daosheng!

Shi Tianzhi was both surprised and happy about Lu Daosheng's sudden visit. He could not have imagined that this person would actually come to his small place.

Since the Hongmeng small world was taken into account by Lu Daosheng, the Hongmeng small world has also begun to develop rapidly.

The whole world is thriving.

Until Lu Daosheng left the Ten Thousand Spirit Realm, Lu Daosheng released the Hongmeng small world and threw it into the deserted city of the Ten Thousand Spirit Realm.

As long as people in the small world are willing to work hard, they will one day ascend to the world of all spirits and be guided by the powerful people in the desert city.

However, there are very few people like Shi Tianzhi who ascended in the opposite direction.

"I didn't expect that I would meet you when I revisited the old place."

Lu Daosheng smiled, his eyes retracted from the distance, and looked at Shi Tianzhi.

He was confused again before, and in order to find an answer, he began to travel around the world. Soon after, he became a little tired of it, so he returned to the place where the dream began.

Tianxuan Continent.

What he didn't expect was that as soon as he entered the Tianxuan Continent, he felt a familiar aura.

With his current strength, the Tianxuan Continent is too small for him and has no privacy.

The same is true for Shi Tianzhi.

So Lu Daosheng easily sensed Shi Tianzhi.

It is both a revisiting place and an old friend, and there is no reason not to see it.

So Lu Daosheng came.

"Mr. City Lord, I wish you good luck. The Tianxuan Continent is developing very well now."

"Looking back then, when we were still in the Saint King Realm, we were already invincible in the world, but now, the powerful people in the Saint King Realm of Tianxuan Continent have gone everywhere."

Now in Tianxuan Continent, only the unknown realm can be considered a strong person.

(Qi Refining, Innate Spirit Master, Breaking the Air, Concentrating the Spirit, Dividing the Soul, Divine Mansion, Life and Combination, Saint, Saint King, Quasi-Emperor, Emperor, Heavenly Emperor, Dao Realm, Ancient Realm, Unknown Realm, Cause and Effect Realm, Life and Death Realm, Reincarnation Realm)

And after passing the realm of reincarnation, you can ascend.

Shi Tianzhi's words were not to compliment Lu Daosheng, but to his true feelings and heartfelt words.

Since he came back, he has been sighing often.

Times change, things change.

Sometimes he is a little lonely, but as time goes by, he becomes accustomed to it.

A comfortable life has always been his yearning.

Now he is ready to enjoy the rest of his life early.

Lu Daosheng did not answer Shi Tianzhi's words, but closed his eyes and pondered.

After a long time, he slowly opened his eyes, but his eyes were filled with a little worry.

Shi Tianzhi was very surprised when he saw this scene and quickly spoke, "What are the worries of the city lord? Shi is willing to share your worries."

However, Lu Daosheng still didn't say anything, just sighed silently.

This made Shi Tianzhi a little anxious and asked, "But Shi was not well-received?"

Lu Daosheng shook his head.

"That should be the matter of Huangcheng."

The only thing that could make Lu Daosheng like this was Shi Tian’s thoughts was the only one in the deserted city.

Sure enough, Lu Daosheng was silent and did not deny it.

This made Shi Tianzhi quickly get up and go forward and say, "Master Lord, under your leadership, Huangcheng will definitely not make any mistakes. Why do you sigh?"

Lu Daosheng looked up at the sky with deep eyes, "What would you do if I said that the world would be destroyed soon?"

Hearing such words, Shi Tianzhi was slightly stunned, and then smiled and said, "Don't joke with me, Lord."

Lu Daosheng said nothing.

Shi Tianzhi:...

It's not big brother, you really come.

Shi Tianzhi's smile gradually became bitter, he just wanted to spend his life peacefully.

Looking at Lu Daosheng in front of him, Shi Tianzhi wanted to speak, but when he reached his mouth, he swallowed it again.

"Speak whatever you want to ask."

Lu Daosheng said bluntly.

Shi Tianzhi smiled bitterly and said, "Master Lord, do you have a solution?"

Lu Daosheng shook his head. There is no one yet. This is why I am a little worried.

After hearing that even Lu Daosheng had no solution, Shi Tianzhi felt relieved after experiencing a brief despair.

Under Lu Daosheng's gaze, Shi Tianzhi sat back slowly, leaned back, and took a very comfortable position.

"Just treat it as a dream of spring and autumn, and death sooner or later will die."

Seeing Shi Tianzhi's decadent appearance, Lu Daosheng shook his head and smiled, "It's not that pessimistic."

"I don't have a solution now, how do you know I won't?"

Seeing Shi Tianzhi closing his eyes slightly and being indifferent, Lu Daosheng sighed and stood up and walked out.

Before leaving, Lu Daosheng said again: "If there is trouble in the deserted city, are you willing to help?"

As soon as these words came out, Shi Tianzhi opened his eyes immediately, "That's natural."

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng nodded, "Then I will give you a ride."

While speaking, Lu Daosheng spread his palms and a fluorescent light appeared, and then shot towards Shi Tianzhi.

Buzz —

Suddenly, the surrounding space floated.

Before Shi Tianzhi could react, his whole body was instantly sucked into the space tunnel.

Lu Daosheng stood there, looking at the place where Shi Tianzhi disappeared, and whispered: "Go, it's time to understand."

Feeling the starlight around him constantly passing by, Shi Tianzhi cried in his heart, "Master Lord, you are too fast!"

He was pulled away as soon as he finished speaking.

But he wasn't very disgusted, but it was too sudden.

After all, I may meet those old friends even after I go there.

At the same time, he began to think about what Lu Daosheng said, is there any problem in the deserted city?

What's the difficulty in the deserted city?

And at this moment, Lu Daosheng's voice sounded from his mind.

"You go to the Chaos Realm and inform the people of the Huangcheng that the land of the gods will invade the Chaos Realm soon."

"Chaos Realm, the Land of Gods?"

Before Shi Tianzhi understood what was going on, he sensed the breath in his body and began to increase wildly.

"Huh? There's still this benefit?"

"Thank you, Lord, for yourselves!"
